title: Canonical affine base-change coordinate rings and sheafification
statement: Let $I$ be a preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $i\in I$, and $t:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Put $J=\{j\mid i\le j\}$, $Y_j=Z\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}R_j$, and $F_j=\Gamma(Y_j,\mathcal O)$. Transition maps are global sections of the canonical base-change maps. For a cocone $c$ on $R$ put $Y=Z\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}c.pt$; the canonical maps $Y\to Y_j$ give a cocone of rings $F_j\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O)$. For a ring map $r:A\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$ define the associated-sheaf functor by $M\mapsto(W\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)\to\operatorname{Spec}A)^*\widetilde M$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Its termwise extension followed by derived localization is affineDescentRealization [def-pc-derived-category]. All constructions are specified functors, with their identity, composition and naturality proofs.
